requiredRoomProperties: dedicated controlled test room or operator-owned private room
room can be listed with createClient().getChatRooms using explicit auth target
room membership is known and limited to controlled participants
room retention or cleanup behavior is documented before send
disallowedTargets: rooms discovered only by name without stable id readback
rooms containing unrelated users or private operational history
any room requiring credential or profile mutation to access during this bead

minimumPolicy: prefer a dedicated disposable room whose contents are acceptable to persist
if platform TTL exists, record TTL and expiry readback before send
if no delete or TTL exists, message content must be harmless, self-identifying, non-secret, and tagged as a test artifact
do not rely on undeclared message deletion as cleanup

messageTextRequirements: include the client nonce exactly once
include no secrets, credentials, private room history, user PII, or operational tokens
stay short enough for deterministic readback matching
requiredResponseIdentity: message id returned by /api/chat/send if provided
room id echoed or tied to response
sender address or agent id if provided
ownedMessageIdStrategy.fallbackIdentity: match by controlled room id plus exact client nonce in getChatMessages readback

requiredSteps: pre-read getChatMessages for controlled room and record last seen cursor/count without persisting private message bodies
send exactly one message with the owned client nonce
post-read getChatMessages for controlled room until the returned message id or exact client nonce appears
record bounded polling window, final verdict, and sanitized response shape
if a delete or expiry path exists, prove cleanup or expiry readback; otherwise classify as acceptable persistent test artifact only if the controlled room policy allowed it before send
successCriteria: send response identity captured or fallback nonce readback matched
message appears only in the controlled room
sender identity matches the explicit credential target
no unrelated room content or credential material is persisted

exclusionReasons: no controlled room id or room ownership evidence exists
no cleanup, expiry, or acceptable-retention policy is proven
no owned message id strategy is implemented in a maintained probe
no maintained execute gate exists for chat.message.send
no post-send getChatMessages readback lane is proven

successorAggregation.recommendation: Do not include chat-send in the successor live proof packet. Re-open only after a no-spend room/readback fixture and maintained execute-gated probe exist.
